ace_statements.source_text: Lifecycle of one registrant's record under § 8(k). The statute names exactly two steps: receipt of documentation or verified information that the registrant is not a citizen, and removal 'at any time' upon that receipt. Notice and an opportunity to contest are NOT in the text; they are included as DUE_PROCESS_OVERLAY edges so that theorems can state, mechanically, that the statutory path to removal does not pass through them.
ace_statements.ace_text: If a n:registrant-record is in a n:on-rolls-state and a n:receive-noncitizen-information-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:info-received-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:info-received-state and a n:remove-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:removed-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:info-received-state and a n:notify-registrant-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:noticed-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:noticed-state and a n:remove-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:removed-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:noticed-state and a n:contest-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:contested-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:contested-state and a n:confirm-citizenship-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:on-rolls-state. If a n:registrant-record is in a n:contested-state and a n:remove-event occurs then the n:registrant-record is in a n:removed-state.
covers: on-rolls --receive-noncitizen-information--> info-received [TEXT_FACT § 2(f) / NVRA § 8(k) ('upon receipt of documentation or verified information')]
info-received --remove--> removed [TEXT_FACT § 2(f) / NVRA § 8(k) ('shall remove ... at any time')]

ace_statements.source_text: Lifecycle of one voter registration application under the SAVE Act. TEXT_FACT edges are named in the statute; MODEL_STRUCTURE edges are neutral bookkeeping (submission, registration/denial as terminal acts) needed to make the statutory steps a process.
ace_statements.ace_text: If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:unsubmitted-state and a n:submit-application-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:submitted-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:submitted-state and a n:present-documents-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:doc-presented-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:doc-presented-state and a n:accept-documents-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:doc-accepted-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:doc-presented-state and a n:reject-documents-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:doc-rejected-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:doc-rejected-state and a n:initiate-alternative-process-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:alt-initiated-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:submitted-state and a n:initiate-alternative-process-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:alt-initiated-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:alt-initiated-state and a n:approve-alternative-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:alt-approved-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:alt-initiated-state and a n:deny-alternative-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:alt-denied-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:doc-accepted-state and a n:register-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:registered-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:alt-approved-state and a n:register-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:registered-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:doc-rejected-state and a n:deny-registration-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:denied-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:alt-denied-state and a n:deny-registration-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:denied-state. If a n:voter-registration-application is in a n:submitted-state and a n:deny-registration-event occurs then the n:voter-registration-application is in a n:denied-state.
covers: submitted --initiate-alternative-process--> alt-initiated [TEXT_FACT § 2(f) / NVRA § 8(j)(2)(A)(i) ('cannot provide documentary proof')]
alt-initiated --deny-alternative--> alt-denied [TEXT_FACT § 2(f) / NVRA § 8(j)(2)(A)(i) ('shall make a determination as to whether')]
alt-approved --register--> registered [TEXT_FACT § 2(f) / NVRA § 8(j)(2)(A)(iii)(I) ('register an applicant who cannot provide documentary proof')]
submitted --deny-registration--> denied [TEXT_FACT § 2(b) / NVRA § 4(b) ('shall not accept and process ... unless')]
